title: fix(cron): scheduled session failures lose their cause
body:
Closes #195802

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: a scheduled session turn that fails shows only `Session event execution failed` in run history and disabled-job diagnostics.

## User Impact

User impact: operators see the real cause (for example the missing account binding and its repair command) when a scheduled automation fails.

## Why This Change Was Made

The generic placeholder was recorded first, so the failed operation's own cause was never used. The placeholder now only applies when no cause exists.

## Evidence

- New `thrown` case in `session-event-automation-result.test.ts`: red on base, green with the fix.
- `session-event-automation-result`, `run.operator-continuation` tests and `pnpm tsgo:core` pass.
- Built Gateway proof (main and candidate, two rounds each, with success and timeout controls): https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/195901#issuecomment-6840901912

<summary>Agent transcript (trimmed)</summary>

**User:** Pick the open issue you are most confident fixing, with no PR yet, and open a PR.

**Agent:** Listed open bugs with no linked PR. Chose #195802: a scheduled session turn that throws is reported as "Session event execution failed", losing the cause.

**Agent:** Traced it: `settleSessionEventTurn` sets a generic failure first, so `finish()` in `session-event-handoff.ts` never uses the operation's recorded cause.

**Agent:** Added a `thrown` case to `session-event-automation-result.test.ts`. Red on base (`Session event execution failed`).

**Agent:** Marked the generic text as a placeholder and let the recorded cause win in `finish()`. Test green. `run.operator-continuation` still expects "Session event execution aborted"; kept by limiting the placeholder to failed turns.

**Agent:** Ran `session-event-automation-result`, `run.operator-continuation`, `agent-runner-execution-session-events`, `session-event-handoff`, `timer-outcomes.regression` tests, and `pnpm tsgo:core`.

</details>
